title: HMNH person research
description: Describe the person, or a skill and a place. Only public professional sources are read.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: Research one person, or find people who have a skill in a place.
enumTitles: Find people by skill and place

purposeConfirmed.title: I confirm a legitimate purpose
purposeConfirmed.description: Required. Tick this only if you have a lawful, professional reason to research this person, such as hiring.

goal.title: Goal
goal.description: What the research is for. It changes what is looked for and how the rating is worded.

name.title: Name
name.description: Full name of the person (person mode).

location.title: Location
location.description: City or region of the person (person mode), or the place to search in (skill search mode).

employers.title: Employers
employers.description: Companies the person is known to have worked for.

roles.title: Roles
roles.description: Job titles the person is known to have held.

skills.title: Skills
skills.description: Skills that help to tell the right person from namesakes.

links.title: Known profile links
links.description: Profile or website addresses of the person. Known profiles skip the guessing step.

focus.title: Focus
focus.description: Optional topic to look at more closely.

requirements.title: Requirements
requirements.description: Optional list of requirements to rate the person against, for example [{"kind": "skill", "label": "Python", "priority": "must"}]. Kinds: language, skill, experience, education, certification, location.

networks.title: Sources
networks.description: Which sources to read. Leave empty for all of them.

strictness.title: Match strictness
strictness.description: How closely a profile must match before it is accepted as the same person.

scepticism.title: Scepticism
scepticism.description: How much distrust is applied when rating.

maxWebPages.title: Public web pages to read
maxWebPages.description: Upper limit of ordinary web pages read per person.

skill.title: Skill
skill.description: The skill to look for (skill search mode).

limit.title: Number of candidates
limit.description: How many candidates to return in skill search mode.

llmProvider.title: Language model provider
llmProvider.description: Leave empty to use the AI models of your Apify account. Pick another provider to use your own key.

llmApiKey.title: Language model API key
llmApiKey.description: Only needed when a provider is picked above. The key is stored as a secret.

llmModel.title: Language model name
llmModel.description: Optional. A sensible default is used.
